concepts.def: Narrow your project to a precise angle on the Spanish-speaking world - one country, period or debate - rather than a vague general theme.
Gather facts, statistics and examples from several Spanish-language sources and note where each piece of evidence comes from.
Open the oral by presenting your key findings concisely, signposting the structure of what you discovered.
Defend your conclusions under questioning: concede partially with 'hasta cierto punto' and counter with 'no obstante' or 'al contrario'.
Analytical phrases strengthen answers: esto demuestra que, los datos sugieren que, una de las causas principales es.
Structure the discussion logically - introducción, hallazgos (findings), conclusiones - and link sections with clear connectives.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Independent Research Project — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Independent Research Project brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Independent Research Project.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: An independent research project for Spanish must focus on what?
options: An aspect of the society or culture of the Spanish-speaking world
Any topic from any country
English literature
The examiner's hobbies

mcqs.q: What does 'los datos demuestran que...' mean?
options: The data show that...
The dates are wrong because...
The gifts prove that...
The files are missing since...

mcqs.q: To partially concede a point in a debate, you could say what?
options: Hasta cierto punto, estoy de acuerdo
No tengo ni idea
¿Dónde está la biblioteca?
Me gusta el fútbol

mcqs.q: Which preparation best supports the discussion of your research?
options: Deep, flexible knowledge of your findings and sources
A memorised script recited word for word
Reading the sources for the first time that morning
Preparing answers only in English

mcqs.q: Is the independent research project assessed as a written report?
options: It is assessed through a multiple-choice test.
Only printed books may be used as sources.
No - it is presented and discussed in the speaking examination, where you summarise findings and answer questions on them.
You hand in a long written dossier that is marked separately.

mcqs.q: Is one good source enough for the research project?
options: No - you should compare several varied sources, which lets you contrast viewpoints and judge reliability.
It means 'to make something real estate'.
A single detailed article gives you everything you need.
Only printed books may be used as sources.
It means 'to realise' something in your mind.
It means 'to make something real estate'.
To carry out or to achieve, as in 'realizar una encuesta' - to carry out a survey.
It is assessed through a multiple-choice test.
